name: Qilin Mimikatz Access Token Module Behavior
description: Detects Mimikatz access-token theft and reuse (token::elevate, token::list, token::run), a privilege-escalation technique used by Qilin ransomware operators. Fires when a non-system executable opens a SYSTEM process token source (winlogon, services, lsass, svchost, csrss, smss, wininit, lsaiso, WmiPrvSE, dllhost, spoolsv, taskhostw, LogonUI) with token-duplication rights, followed within 1 minute by a SYSTEM process spawned from a non-system parent on the same host.
author: https://johannweingertner.github.io
note:
## Triage
1. Check `process.executable` from the ProcessAccess event: verify the file hash on VirusTotal
2. Check the SYSTEM child process from the second event: a SYSTEM `cmd.exe`, `powershell.exe`, or unknown binary whose parent is the suspicious executable confirms token elevation (`token::elevate`).
3. Pivot on `host.name` for other suspicious activity around the same time
query:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=1m
  [process where host.os.type == "windows" and event.code == "10" and
   winlog.event_data.TargetImage : (
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\winlogon.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\services.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\lsass.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\svchost.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\svchost.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\csrss.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\smss.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\wininit.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\lsaiso.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\lsaiso.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\wbem\\wmiprvse.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\wbem\\wmiprvse.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\wbem\\WmiPrvSE.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\wbem\\WmiPrvSE.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\dllhost.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\dllhost.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\spoolsv.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\spoolsv.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\taskhostw.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\taskhostw.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\LogonUI.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\LogonUI.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\logonui.exe",
     "?:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\logonui.exe"
   ) and
   winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess : (
     "0x40", "0x0040", "0x0440", "0x1040", "0x1440", "0x1400", "0x1410", "0x1438", "0x143a", "0x1fffff", "0x1FFFFF"
   ) and
   not process.executable : (
     "C:\\Windows\\System32\\*",
     "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*",
     "C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\*",
     "*\\msedge.exe",
     "*\\msedgewebview2.exe",
     "*\\elastic-otel-collector.exe",
     "*\\Sysmon64.exe",
     "*\\Sysmon.exe",
     "*\\OneDriveStandaloneUpdater.exe"
   )]
  [process where host.os.type == "windows" and event.code == "1" and
   user.id == "S-1-5-18" and
   process.parent.executable != null and
   not process.parent.executable : (
     "C:\\Windows\\System32\\*",
     "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*",
     "C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*",
     "C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\*",
     "*\\msedge.exe",
     "*\\msedgewebview2.exe"
   )]
